After two years of closed borders and La Nina rains, Bondi is back open for business. Lifeguards haven't dealt with big crowds for a while so when 30,010 beach goers descend on Bondi on Christmas Day, they are on high alert.

Newbie Max paddles 600 metres to reach a lone swimmer treading water near shark nets. Lifeguards attend to skate park injuries, and newbie Tyson tests his skate skills with a pro. Lifeguards Jackson and John both attend to a woman struggling in the surf.

Huge waves hit Bondi, leading Bisho to perform a cliff-face rescue with just flippers and a rescue tube. Trainee Taco faces consequences for rookie errors but earns redemption with the rescue of the season as a woman is caught beyond the waves in enormous surf.

A local Bondi surf photographer aids lifeguards in saving a Nepalese tourist, but the battle to keep him alive continues on the sand. Lifeguards spot a swimmer being held underwater by another man fighting for his life. 'Jewellery Rescue' arrive at Bondi to search for a missing wedding ring.

It's pack up time and Chappo sees a swimmer struggling to keep their head above water. Without a rescue board, Chappo sprints down the beach and dives into the water. Bagus doesn't want other lifeguards knowing he is participating in a nude photo shoot with two and half thousand other people.

Despite being an overweight kid without a surfing background, Reidy has overcome harsh criticism to become a lifeguard, setting his sights on a world record. Lifeguards must rescue a girl blown kilometres out to sea on a paddle board. A BMX rider has a fractured cheek and broken nose.

A swimmer in trouble refuses rescue. Faddy deals with reports of a motionless man on the sand. Bagus races out to help a lifesaver tangled in rescue equipment ropes. Reidy and Corey look after two drunk girls who find it difficult to stand up.

One of the most dramatic Bondi rescue episodes ever. When lifeguards attend a man complaining of chest pains, he suddenly has a cardiac arrest in front of them. They perform CPR desperately trying to resuscitate him. Later a beach goer suffers an agonising dislocated knee.

Lifeguards conduct an experiment with dangerous current signs, attaching stickers offering cash rewards for those who read the signs. After 4 days no one has collected any money, and lifeguards rescue a whole family directly in front of the signs.

When a backpacker has a violent seizure for over 15 minutes, team leader Beardy fears long-term consequences. In the water, Sam attempts a daring move during a dangerous rescue, while fellow rookie Luke swallows his pride after an embarrassing blunder.

Riding on the jet ski, Reidy spots a shark off Bondi. As more shark sightings are reported by beachgoers, lifeguards sound the alarm. Later Jake must retrieve a dead body, it's an emotional job in a tough season for the young lifeguard.

Lifeguards anticipate some well-deserved rest as Bondi's summer winds down, but a sudden monster swell brings unexpected challenges. Corey grapples with rescuing swimmers in massive waves. Trainees Ryan and Glick aim to impress in the upcoming lifeguard challenge.
The lifeguards are alarmed when they spot an aggressive beachgoer wielding a knife. They decide to take the beach buggy to chase him down.

Lifeguards honour their former colleague Terry with a traditional paddle out. Lifeguards are concerned when friends of a man missing for an hour reveal he was upset when they last saw him. Lifeguards compete in their annual run, swim and paddle race & one lifeguard organises some banned assistance.

During storm season, a tornado hits Southern Sydney. Tourists brave the waves at Bondi. Jesse, alone in the tower, can't assist a drowning man as all lifeguards are busy in the water. Two thrill-seekers encounter trouble in the big swell, and a British rapper embraces the storm to feel the music.

Set during WW II, follows US military units during the Battle of Normandy and the Allied liberation of France.

In Italy during World War II, a squad of American soldiers is scattered by sniper fire, leaving one soldier, Pvt. Small (George Cooper), trapped inside a foxhole. Pvt. Coke (Richard Kiley) reports back to camp and presses his commanding officer, Sgt. Joe Mooney (Lee Marvin), to dispatch a rescue team. But orders for the division to pull out of the area place the squad in the uncomfortable position of attempting the rescue at the risk of going against military protocol.

Maj. Stringer (Jose Ferrer) needs to assemble a crack squad of British Royal Marines for a highly unusual mission. Though Capt. Thompson (Trevor Howard) is extremely skeptical, he dutifully helps his new superior recruit and train the needed men. Their audacious plan involves transporting a small group of soldiers by submarine to the coast of occupied France, where they will kayak along an estuary into a Nazi shipyard and commit sabotage. Chances for success are very small.

Posted in France, Pvt. Hogan (Jack Lemmon) falls hard for Betty Bixby (Kathryn Grant), a nurse who happens to be a lieutenant, which means they are forbidden to fraternize due to their ranks. Always one to skirt the rules, Hogan, with the help of his friend Cpl. Bohun (Dick York), cooks up a scheme to throw a clandestine ball for all the soldiers and nurses. But the two have their work cut out for them when the authoritative Capt. Paul Lock (Ernie Kovacs) starts breathing down their necks.

When the tiny nation of Grand Fenwick's only export, a special wine, begins to be produced in California, their entire economy collapses. Things look dire until Prime Minister Rupert Mountjoy (Peter Sellers) points out that no country that has declared war on the United States has ever gone hungry. When Field Marshall Tully Bascombe (Peter Sellers) and the 23 other men in the Grand Fenwick army invade the United States, their plan to immediately surrender unravels.

Detective Sherlock Holmes and Dr. John Watson join forces to investigate a mysterious murder at Buckingham Palace. It seems like an open-and-shut case as all signs point to Professor James Moriarty, the criminal mastermind and longtime nemesis of the crime-solving duo. A brutal storm causes their plane to crash in the frozen wilderness, and only eight men, including Ottway, survive. As they trek southward toward civilization and safety, Ottway and his companions must battle mortal injuries, the icy elements, and a pack of hungry wolves.

The unthinkable happens when heavily armed and highly trained terrorists launch a bold daytime attack on the White House. Luckily for Asher, former presidential security officer Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) is on the scene. With time running out, it's up to Banning to locate Asher's son before the extremists do and rescue the president before his captors unleash their ultimate plan.

Dr. Kim chooses the extreme method to save Minister Ryu. After Dr. Kim manages to bring Minister Ryu back to life, Min Kook starts doubting Dr. Kim's real intention and skills. After Min Kook announces the Minister's condition to the press, Dr. Kim just doesn't seem to care. Eun Jae asks Woo Jin to attend the second surgery, but he refuses.

Min Kook asks Woo Jin questions about the primary surgery that Dr. Kim operated on, and Woo Jin hesitates to answer them. The director of Doldam Hospital comes back to the hospital, and Ah Reum greets him. Eun Jae gets furious at Woo Jin for taking away her opportunity to be in the second operation with Min Kook. And Doldam Hospital is on the verge of being sued for malpractice.

Friday is the busiest day as a lot of patients swarm in Doldam Hospital. Eun Jae still finds it hard to perform surgical operations herself. A girl patient who suffers from drug poisoning because of her father's joint family suicidal attempt reminds Woo Jin of a painful memory from his childhood. And the staff of Doldam Hospital resents after hearing a rumor that there will be a new director.

A detective with a gunshot wound and a gang boss with a stab wound come into the ER at the same time. Both of them want Dr. Kim to do the operation, but that's just impossible. Meanwhile, Nurse Oh finds a note at the director's office and notices something is going on with the director. Eun Jae finds a beaten wife in the bathroom and confronts her husband, but something unexpected happens.

Nurse Oh finds out that Director Yeo has lung cancer. A loan shark comes to the hospital and makes a scene to embarrass Woo Jin. Eun Jae feels uncomfortable for causing trouble, so she decides to apologize. Doldam hospital gets a call, and Dr. Kim and Min Guk fiercely conflict over a patient from prison.
A film capturing a journey across Korea, collecting the diverse sounds of everyday life and bringing them together to create a single piece of music.

Eun Jae loses her confidence from the domestic violence incident, and Dr. Kim cheers her up by telling her that it isn't her fault. Eun Jae finds out that Woo Jin had lost his parents when he was young.

When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some "groove booties" programmed to dance to any beat. She temporarily impresses her friends with her dance moves, but when the groove booties go out of control and threaten the town's Berryball game, she is forced to fess up.

When the girls discover that Apple's groove booties can teach the pups to dance, Plum gets an idea for a Doggie Dance Show. Wanting to impress them, Huck offers to have TomTom join the show... despite the pup's obvious dislike of performing in public. It's up to Strawberry to help Huck see that he should not force TomTom into something he just doesn't want to do.

When a simple tune Cherry composes goes viral on the Berryweb, Cherry quickly gets fed up with everyone listening to this song, everywhere, all the time. She goes to comic lengths to get some peace so she can compose the song she's suppose to write for the Queen of Berryvania.

Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. Strawberry good-naturedly chuckles at her antics. But Orange gets her dander up and wades into the water to face her "attacker." When she looks down into the water, gazing up at her is the cutest, most adorable, puffy-cheeked fish she's ever seen. It's love at first sight. Orange has to take him home.

At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! Berry Bitty City is decorated with colorful banners proclaiming the big event. Lemon works the hardest. For weeks she has watered her violets by day and sung to them at night, doing everything she can to win first prize. With the contest just a day away, Lemon is at her garden early.

Strawberry Shortcake's friends watch her with wide eyes as she everrrrr-so-gently squirts a layer of blueberry smoothie into a tall glass, trying to not disturb the five other multi-colored layers beneath it. It's her tenth attempt to create the world's first Rainbow Smoothie! She has even painted one wall of her café rainbow colors in honor of the soon-to-be new item on the menu. No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon  it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. All the girls are getting their hair done for the gala grand opening of Mr. Longface's new lawn-bowling and croquet club. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

Blueberry ordered some Zippy Gro daisy seeds and planted them in her garden. She is surprised that they've sprouted in less than a day despite their descriptive moniker. Strawberry comes by to admire them and Blueberry is reminded that the new cookbook Strawberry ordered has arrived. Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. Strawberry follows the muffin recipe, mixes the ingredients, and double checks it.

programmes.st: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programmes.d: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence  a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a strangerthe crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniquesto trace a lethal encounter.

Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard.  In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

Some killers choose to hide their victims  And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder  These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.
Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.
When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.

Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programmes.t: The Last House on the Left
programmes.d: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

The story of a down-and-out con artist who trades lifestyles with a well-to-do investor.
A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programmes.d: An overzealous news photographer accidentally takes a picture of Ickis while trying to capture one of a rock star.  Ickis, while trying to give Simon the Monster Hunter a nightmare, gets sucked into his brain.

programmes.st: Into The Woods/Krumm Gets The Dreaded Nolox
programmes.d: Ickis has to perform a group scare so he turns to a human he knows for help.   Krumm gets a bad case of hiccoughs known to monsters as The Dreaded Nolox.  It's up to Oblina and Ickis to find a cure.

programmes.st: Mayberry U.F.O. / I Dream of Snorch with the Long Golden Hair
programmes.d: Heavy rains wash Ickis, Krumm and Oblina through the sewer and into a backwards rural town.  They are mistaken for aliens and must escape from the rural mob.   On a dare inspired by Oblina, Ickis and Krumm steal the Snorch's prized golden nosehair.
On a beautiful spring day, Ickis, Krumm and Oblina frolic in a fresh pile of garbage only to find that they have inadvertently boarded a garbage barge headed for the wide open seas.

programmes.st: Monster Who Came in from the Cold / Puppy Ciao
programmes.d: Oblina infiltrates the human race in a "human suit."  When the suit malfunctions, and she thinks she's human, Ickis and Krumm have to rescue her.  While above the ground, a puppy saves Ickis from being run over.

Norb, who's four minutes older, has always been just a wee bit taller than Dag (something he relishes). His world is turned upside down when Dag shows up for their weekly measuring and has grown to be a wee bit taller than him.
A visit from their country cousin, who looks and acts like a real beaver, annoys Dag but prompts Norb to go back to nature. When he finds out he won't have to take baths anymore, Dag follows.

The boys take a voyage to the bottom of the pond in their own Beaver-rigged submarine, the Norbalus. / A family of freeloading otters moves in on the boys, turns their lives upside down and threatens to take over their dam.

programmes.st: Dagski & Norb / Shell or High Water
programmes.d: The Beavers are two tough, street-smart detectives in a broad send-up of 70's cop shows. / The boys' typical squabbling falls by the wayside for a day of brotherly togetherness.
Two hoods mistake Tommy for a millionaire's kid and kidnap him./The Rugrats embark on a jungle adventure.
Grandpa is supposed to play his trumpet at a Picnic, but Spike runs off with his dentures./Didi and Stu take Tommy to a baby psychologist after he crayons on the wall.
While watching a scary show a kid discovers his dad is really a robot./Tommy climbs in a bag and ends up at the post office where he's mistaken for a piece of mail.

programmes.st: Candy Bar Creep Show / Monster in the Garage
programmes.d: Stu and Didi build a haunted house for Halloween and the Rugrats sneak in, looking for Reptar bars.   The adults blame Spike for mysterious accidents in the garage, but Tommy believes his pet is innocent.
Didi decides it's time to wean Tommy from the bottle./Tommy gets excited when he sees a pyramid display of Reptar cereal boxes at the supermarket.

The dads are watching football, the Rugrats are in their pen and Angelica decides she wants Tommy's chocolate milk bottle.   The Rugrats stage a trial to determine who broke Tommy's clown lamp. Each kid recounts their story in a dramatic flash-back.

Angelica and her cat, Fluffy, act and look like evil twins. Fluffy breaks some pottery and Spike is wrongly accused.   At the Sleazola Bros. Carnival, a guy is giving samples of Reptar cereal. Angelica runs off with his bag and everyone follows her.
Stu and Didi take Tommy and Angelica on a car trip to the Grand Canyon./Tommy and Chuckie accidentally toss their glider plane into the scary basement.
Tommy and Chuckie accidentally are left in a huge toy store after closing.   After Grandpa reads them a pirate story, Tommy, Chuck, Phil and Lil imagine that they're buccaneers on the high seas.
Doug Can't Dance/Doug Gets Busted: Doug is excited about attending the school dance with Patti until the class bully, Roger, reminds him that he can't dance.

Doug's Dog Date/Doug's Big Nose: Porkchop falls in love with an alluring girl dog, and Doug fears he will lose Porkchop as his best friend.   When Skeeter's baby brother Dale calls Doug "big nose", he becomes obsessed with his schnozz.

Oblina, long used to being the star pupil, finds herself challenged to the limit by a gifted transfer student from another dump.  Ickis steals a magicians hat, assuming that its powers will make him the most popular monster at the academy.
When a human designer realeases a new fragrance, the monsters discover it works as a toxic gas against them.  Oblina's not superstitious, but when she  steps on a slug her luck changes.

programmes.st: Nice and Lonely/Soccer, I Hardly Know Him
programmes.d: The Beavers' needy tree lizard buddy Bing turns his geekiness into celebrity when he writes a book about the joys of loneliness.  Norb jumps on the “Bing-wagon” while Dag still thinks he's just an annoying pest.

Beaver fact: Beavers use tail slaps on water to warn others when danger threatens. Dag abuses this natural alarm, causing Norb to call in their dad to set things right. / Daggett and Norbert are both unaware that the other is at home.
Debbie discovers Eliza talking to dingoes and threatens to tell her parents. Eliza is afraid of being shipped back to the United States as a science experiment, seeks help from nearby Aborigines.

The Thornberrys meet the Fensterkopfs, who make false documentaries. The Fensterkopf's kid lies to Eliza and gets them stuck on a cliff.  After the families barely escape an avalanche, the value of truth is learned by all.
The Thornberrys discover that koalas are missing from their native groves. Eliza decides to unravel the mystery only to discover Kip and Biederman master minding this evil plot.
After a botched weightlifting routine, Josh injures his toe and is forced to the hospital. Drake wants nothing to do with this until a bodacious young nurse catches his eye.
A six-year-old argument between Drake and Josh is suddenly rekindled when their conflicting accounts of a incident at a San Diego Padres game finds them each placing the blame on the other.
Drake's new girlfriend might be tougher than him.  Josh trying to impress Mindy's parents might be even tougher.  Will the boys prevail, or will girl power rule the day?
When Drake and Josh find out Megan have adopted a pet sheep, they want nothing to do with it.
Josh gets a student teaching job in Miranda's classroom, and Drake potentially discovers his new drummer.
Drake gets in trouble at school and is assigned to mentor a young boy.  But when Drake's new "little sibling" likes Josh more than Drake, we discover that brotherly love hurts.
When a crime show decides to film reenactments at the Premiere, fantasy and reality collide as Josh uproariously finds himself cast as the lead.  San Diego's most wanted Movie Bandit!
Drake decides that he and Josh are going to be the first to ride the Demonator, the fastest and scariest rollercoaster opening tomorrow at Mystic Mountain.
When Drake and Josh decide to turn the tables and prank little Megan, she has the whole family believing that aliens are coming.
In our season finale, Drake and Josh go on the Dr. Phyliss Show and relive some of their most outlandish moments. Some will jab at your funny bone, while others will tug on your heart strings.
With their parents out of town and Megan planning a trip to Denver, Drake and Josh find they'll have the house to themselves for the week.
After Drake forgets Josh's birthday he tries to make it up to him by taking him to a live taping of "Oprah".    Things, however, take a turn when they run into an unexpected guest.
Mrs. Hayfer needs a house sitter and it's the boys to the rescue, but all doesn't go according to plan when they meet Tiberius, a vicious dog with an appetite for..Drake & Josh?!
It's Aunt Catherine's wedding day, and Drake and Josh are in charge of picking up the cake.   But their wedding plans get crashed when their car breaks down.
After Mindy tells Josh she loves him, Josh turns to the only logical place for advice: Drake.
Now that Josh is no longer dating Mindy he wants to play the field and challenges Drake to a bet to see who can score more dates.
Drake and Josh meet the "Great" Henry Doheny, one of the greatest magicians ever - who has fallen on tough times.
Get your chopsticks ready.   The good times roll when the boys work in a sushi factory to earn the money to buy the living room furniture back after an anniversary present for their parents go awry.
The whole gang has gathered at Drake and Josh's house before Drake's big concert, but thanks to Walter's poor weather predictions they end up stuck in the house due to severe rain.
The boys are tired of sharing a ride and get money to buy a car, but all goes bananas when Drake buys an orangutan named Bobo instead.
Drake and Josh accidentally burn down their neighbor's tree house.   Their parents force the boys to rebuild the tree house and Drake and Josh plan to do it quickly.
Drake has taken advantage of Josh for the last time and Josh decides that he is done dealing with Drake.
After Bellview High nerd, Eric Blonnowitz accidentally punches Drake he finds a newfound world of fame, popularity and girls.
After Drake and Josh accidentally kill Megan's pet hamster, they ready themselves for her revenge that could come anywhere, anytime.

After the boys get in trouble for using Fake ID's Audrey and Walter fear they will fall to a life of crime and sign them up for a "Steered Straight" program, but things start skidding out-of-control when a real criminal befriends them
Megan's been extremely secretive and Drake and Josh investigate to find out what she's up to.
The most popular kid in school is throwing what may be the greatest sixteenth party ever, but Drake and Josh may be having cake for two after they get banned from the party.

After Josh ruins Drake's chances at having a hit song in the Superbowl, the boys must find a way to make things right.   Along for the ride are a crazy houseguest, a  bride, and one really big shrimp.
Drake wins a free skydive off a helicopter and goes off to do it despite his parents saying no.   Josh, being the good brother he is, tries to stop him, but ends up going along for the ride.
Blessed with his unconventional dance moves, Josh decides to try out for the local dance contest.
Worlds collide when Drake Parker and Josh Nichols, two very different kids attending the same high school, discover that they're about to become stepbrothers.
Drake and Josh get a Dune Buggy that Trevor brought to their house fixed and want to take it out for a spin, but Audrey and Walter think other ways.

Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags, and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.

Ronna needs to make some extra cash. Simon wants to escape to Vegas for the weekend. Adam and Zack want to stay out of trouble. But it's not just another night in the life of these unusual characters.

Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.
Academy Award winner Al Pacino and Cameron Diaz lead a stellar cast in Oscar-winning Oliver Stone's hard-hitting homage to the gridiron gladiators of Any Given Sunday.

At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game and also finds himself in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.
A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

In 1776, South Carolina widower and legendary war hero Benjamin Martin (Mel Gibson) finds himself thrust into the midst of the American Revolutionary War as he helplessly watches his family torn apart by the savage British Redcoats.

programmes.st: The Knight, Death, and the Devil
programmes.d: Dylan attempts to liberate a fleet of captured ships who aren't sure they want to be liberated. Their AIs fear new captains will enslave them.
Genites attack Tyr's wife and colony, and he discovers that he is a father - and his son may be the genetic reincarnation of Drago Mussevni.

programmes.st: Tunnel at the End of the Light
programmes.d: With 50 parties on board, Dylan hosts the signing of the New Commonwealth charter but soon discovers there are intruders intent on stopping the signing.
Beka and Tyr are taken over by the energy from a dimensional tunnel. Dylan, Trance, and Harper must save them before they destroy the ship.
Dylan is framed for murder and must clear his name, all while finding the pieces of a vase said to grant the owner the "blessings of the cosmos."
The crew rescues a group of refugees, only to discover they have been subject to government experiments and are extremely unstable.
Beka's Uncle Sid runs for office in the New Commonwealth, but an assassination attempt causes the crew to act as his security.
When the Andromeda is attacked by space pirates, they are rescued by a long-lost spaceship from Earth.
The crew discovers that a rogue planet, Marduk, has been creating weapons of mass destruction.
A hitman by the name of the Leper is targeting the leaders of the New Commonwealth.
The Andromeda is haunted by a mysterious creature that comes aboard during a solar storm.

programmes.st: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programmes.d: When a long lost love returns, Tyr disappears from the ship to protect her from an assassin.
Set in an alternate universe where Dylan died and Gaheris Rhade is trying to reform the Commonwealth.
The group that attacked the Andromeda during the first Commonwealth charter signing returns to wreak more havoc.
Trance runs through a number of different scenarios, trying to find one in which her crewmates don't die.
A "more powerful" Andromeda ship explodes due to likely sabotage, forcing Dylan's crew to save them.
In mysterious Venice, Joseph and Caesar begin training under the equally enigmatic Lisa Lisa. Let the Hamon “hell” begin!
Under Lisa Lisa’s tutelage, Joseph and Caesar must endure their final test. But while Caesar hones his skills, Joseph is stunned by an ancient and unexpected foe.
Joseph returns to Lisa Lisa, unaware of the bizarre stowaway he has delivered. A possessed confidant then attacks, ultimately sending the crew to Switzerland, where another revelation awaits.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Race Toward the Brink
programmes.d: Stroheim is back from the brink, now as a cyborg designed to secure the great Red Stone. Kars, however, is not willing to concede and wages war, even as the stone hurtles toward an alpine cliff.
Lisa Lisa paints a picture of honor when she reveals Caesar’s tragic past to Joseph. Meanwhile, in the face of certain danger, Caesar enters into a solitary battle to avenge his father.

Inside a shadowy St. Moritz hotel, danger leaves Joseph and Lisa Lisa no time to mourn as they follow a bloody trail to Wamuu and Kars. Luckily, Lisa Lisa manages to strike a deal—but, of course, with one condition.
Joseph and Wamuu finally face off in an equestrian one-on-one. But will Joseph’s adroit attacks and weapon-grasping prowess be enough to keep Wamuu’s millennia-old pride in check?

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Warrior of Wind
programmes.d: When the battle between Wamuu and Joseph comes to a head, the surprising confessions aren’t far behind. Now the final hour has come for Lisa Lisa and Kars—a fighter very different from his fellow Pillar Men.

When Neek accepts a project in Africa, Charmaine goes to extreme lengths to keep him in Chicago. Lily hooks up with another 9Mag tattoo artist. Don's world is turned upside when he gets news about his sister. Presented by VH1.

Everyone puts their differences aside to honor Don's sister. Lily opens up to JR about her past. Ryan invites the crew to yet another a lake house to make amends, but things go left when Kat shows up. Presented by VH1.
The future of 9MAG hangs in the balance when Ryan drops a bomb on the crew, and Ashley leaves Don after a dirty video makes the rounds.
Sky enlists the crew to help with her fashion show in L.A., Miss Kitty and Young Bae talk about their fight, Alex surprises Donna, and Tatiana reaches her breaking point.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Runner Up For Mother Teresa Number 2
programmes.d: Ceaser reunites with an enemy, Krystal has a much-needed talk with her father, and Sky's twerk fashion show includes a surprise that sends Ceaser over the edge.
Free jackets get in the way of Ceaser squashing his beef with Alex, Tokie refuses to accept peace between Tati and Krystal, and Sky plows ahead with Operation Mend Fences.

After mending fences with Puma, Cease makes him a partner at 113th only to have his decision be questioned during his 40th birthday celebration. Bae struggles to keep her marriage together, while Sky confronts her son Des, about his recent behavior.
Walt brings his new girlfriend by the shop, which causes Donna to catch a flashback. Young Bae and Rob face difficulties in their marriage. Sky is at a crossroads with her relationship with Des.
Kit's mom passes away in D.C and the news rocks the shop. Donna and Walt duke it out over Jessica. Puma hires new girl London and Bae thinks he has a shady, ulterior motive.

Puma hires London to cover for Kitty which disrupts the precarious balance in the shop. Tati has a run in with the law and Donna faces a major financial setback. Puma tries to bring a little kumbaya to 113 but no good deed goes unpunished.

In an effort to support Miss Kitty, Ceaser and the crew head down to Memphis, Tennessee so she can reconnect with her mother's roots. Krystal confronts Donna about her behavior during the lock-in. And Walt makes a serious go at standup comedy.

The crew continues their stay in Memphis to pay their respects to Kitty's mom. London decides to throw a house party to promote the brand down south. Walt prepares to take his relationship with Jessica to the next step.

Ceaser has a new opportunity to expand Black Ink but not everyone is happy with the deal, leaving him to question where loyalties lie. Donna plans a girls' night that's full of rowdy surprises. Walt and Jess can't see eye to eye.

An unexpected drug test has Tati freaking out. Sky announces a huge surprise. Quani makes a decision that shocks Puma. Rok airs out his dirty laundry - literally. And problems with the Brooklyn shop puts Ceaser on a collision course with the police.

Ceaser deals with the fallout of his arrest, and what it means for the Brooklyn shop. Alex and Donna try to get their mojo back in the bedroom. Bae confronts a shocking diagnosis. And Sky embarks on a new venture.

When Danny's car matches an NYPD description of a vehicle involved in a drug deal, he is stopped and taken into custody when a bag of cocaine is found in his trunk.
When a man with multiple rat bites is thrown from a moving car, Danny works the case to find out why and who was trying to send a message.

Before a Hasidic Grand Rebbe passes away, he chooses his youngest son to succeed him. But when the new appointee dies suddenly, Danny investigates the oldest son and others within the Hasidic community.
When a 10-year-old boy is the victim of an incident in the projects, Danny's heated approach to the case lands him in anger management class.
Erin and Danny investigate a cold case of a girl who was attacked by her rich and powerful boyfriend, who was never convicted.
When an off-duty cop tries to stop a bank robbery, he is disarmed by the 'Bonnie and Clyde' robbers who take his gun and wound an innocent bystander.
When the same tragedy occurs to people who don't appear connected, Danny must find what they have in common and who is responsible.
When a religious young woman is murdered, Danny questions her family who is shocked to learn that she had a secret relationship.
When two Wall Street brokers are killed in drug deals, Danny looks to question a wounded accomplice at the hospital but he is stopped by Linda, who won't let Danny see him until after surgery.

When Danny finds a disoriented man in a park covered in his girlfriend's blood, he finds it hard to believe that the man has no recollection of the night's events until they find a strong narcotic in his bloodstream.
When a young woman commits suicide, Danny is emotional since he promised to help her when her parents were taken from her.
As the Reagans rally together to take down the leader of the gang responsible for the murder of someone close to them, Danny looks to the gang leader's girlfriend to lead them to him.
When an armed robbery ends with the death of a police officer, Frank makes it a mission for the NYPD to bring the suspect to justice.
When a famous movie star, Russell Berke, who shadowed Danny for research on his next role, is stabbed, Danny goes to his aid but must keep the crime on the down-low due to Russell’s celebrity status.

Danny becomes the lead hostage negotiator when a prime informant in a large drug case holds Erin at gunpoint inside the courtroom. Also, when Jamie disobeys his lieutenant’s orders and gets suspended, Frank must decide on a proper punishment.
Danny and Baez investigate the death of a teenage girl who appears to have been pushed in front of a subway car by a homeless man.

When Danny and Baez suspect a little girl might be the victim of a kidnapping, the girl’s mother denies it, but her story doesn’t add up. Meanwhile, Frank pays a visit to a priest, a counselor to the NYPD, who was arrested on a DUI charge.
Hoss is conned into buying a violin from a gypsy fortune teller, and everyone on the Ponderosa--except for Hop Sing--suffers the consequences.

On their way to prevent a young woman from encountering the renegade Indians, Joe and Tuck are captured, and in order to save them all, Joe must fight Sharp Tongue, who is the leader of the band who went to school with Joe as a youth.
Ben finds an old journal that he kept while in a wagon train travelling from St. Joseph, Missouri to Ash Hollow.
Moody bounty hunter, Dev Farnum, shows up on the Ponderosa, where the Cartwrights are harboring the wife of the man he is after.
When Hoss is responsible for causing a hung jury, Ben tells him, "a man is never wrong doing what he thinks is right", and Adam attempts to validate his brother's reasonable doubt.

Clay Stafford signs on to work for the Cartwrights and shortly afterwards shoots and kills a man who accuses him of cheating at poker.  The miners warn Clay to leave town, but it appears he killed in self-defense.

The Cartwrights are visited by their second cousin, Muley Jones of Weedville, Missouri who sings with a window-shattering voice and stirs up trouble with Indian negotiations that Ben is trying to ensure.
When mountain man Jim Leyton decides to marry, he chooses Hoss as his best man.  Julie's father, Grizzly, does not agree and Hoss must come to the rescue.
The new stranger in town claims to be the famous pirate Jean Lafitte, and Hoss believes him.
A Mormon with two wives is badgered by the town's people and then things get much worse.
As the persecuted party awaits Ben and Hoss' return, Herber is shot and killed. Joe retaliates and shoots Herber's assassin.
Adam becomes involved with the recently widowed Laura Dayton and her little girl, Peggy.
The mother of a young outlaw condemned to hang, threatens to have her gang's hostages killed if her son is not set free.  One of the hostages is Joe.
Ben must travel to pay his respects after he learns of the death of his nephew Will. When he visits the grave, he finds his nephew barely alive with a bullet wound.
Billy Horne is a white man who was captured by the Shoshone when he was six. He comes into Ben & Joe's campsite one night uninvited.
Ben is attracted to Sarah Reynolds, a member of a religious order led by her fanatical uncle.  When she is accused of being a witch, the Cartwrights step in.
Joe teaches Johnny Chapman how to use a gun for defense.  What Joe doesn't see is the deadly consequences that it has in the long run when Johnny becomes a gunfighter.
Separated from Boruto and Sarada, Konohamaru battles Victor. But someone unexpected shows up to fight alongside him.

Konohamaru and his teammates report their findings that the Kara receives outside assistance from people called Outers, and that these Outers may have covertly infiltrated the Five Great Shinobi Nations.
The Yamanaka Clan, who have been tracking the village’s ingoing and outgoing traffic with their advanced sensory abilities, spearheads a plan to create a new sensory system.
A memorial service is being held in remembrance of the many fallen from the Fourth Great Ninja War.
The mysterious organization known as the Kara is about to take one of their plans to the next stage that involves a crucial item called a “Vessel.”
Boruto, Sarada and Mitsuki are assigned to carry out Team 7’s missions by themselves until Konohamaru returns from an unexpected assignment.
The airship transporting Kara’s Vessel has gone missing, and the Inners call an emergency meeting.
Team 7 is given a mission to escort Katasuke and transport a Scientific Ninja Tool. Stuck on a mission he doesn’t like, Boruto runs into Ao while aboard the Thunder Train headed to their destination.
Boruto and his friends end up cooperating in a test-run of a Scientific Ninja Tool that is under development, and is given a new urgent assignment from the Hokage.
Team 7, along with Katasuke and Chamaru, the Ninja Hound, go to the location where Konohamaru and Mugino's communications cut out and they are attacked by mysterious puppets.
After allowing Boruto and the others to escape, Ao is visited by Koji Kashin.
Team 7 works together to launch a barrage of attacks, but countering Ao’s adept use of Scientific Ninja Tools will not be easy. Just as they seem to have cornered him, Ao reveals his greatest weapon.
As Boruto and his friends finish their battle with Ao, Koji Kashin, a member of Kara, appears!
On their way back to the village, the team discovers an unconscious boy who has the same strange mark on his palm as Boruto.
The battle between Garo—an Outer—and Kawaki—also known as the Vessel—begins!
The team returns to the Advanced Technology Lab with Kawaki. Konohamaru has returned to the village to report on the mission.
Kawaki escapes the Advanced Technology Lab and finds himself in a bustling shopping district. Exhausted and hungry, he desperately searches for food.
Kawaki collapses and is tormented by nightmares from his childhood.
The Five Kage agree to place Kawaki under Naruto’s custody. Naruto takes Kawaki home, but the atmosphere between Boruto and Kawaki turns threatening.
Boruto is furious that Kawaki has broken a vase that his little sister had made for their mother, fanning the flames between them. As a fellow wielder of the Karma, Kawaki makes a proposal.
Kawaki goes into town with Naruto to get a new vase to replace the one that he broke. On the way to the Yamanaka Flower Shop, they are joined by Sarada.
Kawaki watches a Shinobi Hand-to-Hand Combat match between Naruto and Boruto. Boruto uses his specialty, the Shadow Clone Jutsu, to take on his father, but he struggles.
In order to get a better handle on their Karmas, Boruto and Kawaki decide to train under more realistic conditions.
Delta forces her way into the Leaf Village to take Kawaki back and appears before Boruto and the others. In response, Naruto unleashes the power of the Nine Tails, and a fierce clash ensues!
Delta uses her destructive beam that can neutralize any regenerative power. Undaunted, Naruto forcefully suppresses it with a Giant Rasengan.
Delta informs Jigen that Boruto also has a Karma on his palm. Upon hearing this, Jigen smiles…
As Naruto sleeps, Kawaki repairs the vase he broke. Suddenly, Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Beast, appears before him.
Using the Transportation Technique, Sasuke arrives at a strange location that is covered with mysterious inscriptions. There he finds many surprising things about the Otsutsuki Clan.
A direct confrontation between Naruto, the Seventh Hokage, and Jigen, the leader of the Kara, finally begins!
Naruto and Sasuke work together to defeat Jigen in a fierce battle, but they struggle against Jigen's advanced fighting abilities and mysterious jutsu.
With the enemy's sudden appearance, Naruto, the Seventh Hokage and leader of the village, has vanished.
Boruto and the others attack Boro to save Naruto, but Boro drives them back by releasing a mysterious dark mist that paralyses his opponents.
The newly formed Team 7's all-out attack damages Boro, and their efforts seem to be successful. However, Boro uses his regenerative powers to revive himself.

Mike Hammer must fly out to Hollywood to investigate the murder of a B-movie star's boyfriend. However, Hammer discovers an unexpected plot twist...

An unknown odor kills a surgery patient in a hospital and now it is up to Mike Hammer to discover the source. The case takes a shift once Mike finds out details about the chemicals used in surgery.
A prostitute and a priest both end up dead, and Mike Hammer is not the forgiving type. Hammer follows the case to find the man who's targeting hookers and the holy man that wanted to protect them.
Irreplaceable Lautrec and Gauguin art works mysteriously vanish from a millionaire's private collection despite three fail-safe electronic security systems.
Both bearing scars of gangland violence, McGarrett and an elegant dealer in objets d'art, Marni Howard, are sympathetically drawn together.
A Honolulu businessman accuses McGarrett and his investigative team of shaking him down for $100,000 "protection" money. Five-O is under heavy suspicion.

programmes.st: Presenting in the Center Ring Murder
programmes.d: Wo Fat, international spy and relentless nemesis of McGarrett's, reappears in Hawaii in pursuit of a visiting foreign minister who is under the protection of the Five-O unit.

A shamed Japanese banker ritualistically kills himself, and McGarrett want to know why. McGarrett demands answers from a prominent financial consultant and the deceased's assistant when Five-O discovers the pair are involved in an international swindle.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) suspects a newly arrived short-order cook in town may be involved in the recent murder of a young prostitute. Virgil (Howard Rollins) thinks otherwise and is out to prove that a local criminal is to blame.
Hunter searches for the killer of a runaway girl whose baby he helped to deliver.
McCall's friend and former training officer comes to LA for a visit in the midst of a murder investigation and goes quite overboard trying to help her out.
Overcome with guilt over the suicide of her training officer, McCall quits the force and is kidnapped. Hunter sets out to rescue her before it's too late.
A pilot of an airliner carrying Dr. Sloan and Amanda to a medical conference in Europe is murdered.
A wealthy woman and her lover concoct an elaborate scheme to do in her husband.
A comedian (Tim Conway) makes a bumbling attempt to do in his more successful former partner (Harvey Korman)---whose wife turns up dead.
Trivette's brother Simon is in town with drug dealers, trying to arrange a big operation. The Rangers are determined to stop the organization. Simon is told he has to kill his brother.

When Maisie Whitman's son dies unexpectedly, CD tries to determine if he was murdered. He notices that his friend Maisie is having problems with her mind. Meanwhile, the Rangers try to track down an escaped convict.

A young boy is upset that his fireman father never seems to be home. The firemen are busy because a gang is torching homes of witnesses to the gang leader who is on trial for murder. The father is shot as he attempts to put out a fire.

In a law enforcement contest for shooting, strength, and endurance, Walker and Trivette find their matches in law officers from Germany. A preacher's son owes money to a loan shark who tells the son to steal money from his father's charity.
Innocent acceptance of an apparently menial job as a porter at a swank country club, involves Dr. Richard Kimble in a top secret government experiment.
Kimble falls and lands in the home of a Naturopath and finds himself fighting against bad medical practice and romantic advances from his host's wife.
Kimble makes a careless error disclosing his whereabouts and Lt. Gerard, hastily returning from a vacation with his wife, closes in.
MacGyver uncovers an assassination plot against an informer threatening to expose a drug trafficking network.
MacGyver battles ex-cons to save the life of a woman and her unborn child.
MacGyver is on the trail of thieves using high-level Navy tactics to steal the 18th-century treasure.
A mad bomber whom Dr. Sloan helped put away has escaped and wants the good doctor blown away.
When a pregnant woman needs a helping hand, Mike is mistaken for her husband.
Bub acts as the chaperone for Robbie's costume party.
Robbie teaches American customs to a Chinese girl.
The Douglas family get an opportunity to move to Hawaii.
The Driscolls are new neighbors, but problems arise as their phone is on the same line as the Mitchells.
After hearing that the city is tearing down Mr. Dorfman’s “Postman’s Rest” bench in favor of a parking lot, Dennis and Tommy offer him use of their private bench they plan to build.
When Dennis has no one to play with, he decides to walk to his Grandfather’s house, which is miles away!
Dennis and Tommy try to sell Valentine’s Day cards in July to buy swim fins.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Spelling Bee
programmes.d: Kathy is nervous about the school spelling bee, so Betty give her a penny and convinces her that it has special powers.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Bud, The Philanthropist
programmes.d: Bud decides to donate to the church, but gets angry when Kippy makes it appear that he gave money instead of Bud.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Baby In The House
programmes.d: Jim and Margaret decide to baby-sit for Betty so that she can go out.
Jim and Margaret find out that an unsuccessful classmate, who they thought would become a doctor, is actually a bad salesman now and unhappy with his job.

Bill thinks he will have a relaxing day, but the children come in to ask for his help. Jody wants help with a friend, Buffy needs to go to a Brownie meeting, and Cissy wants him to talk to the hospital staff about her being a candy striper.

Buffy goes to dance class but finds her teacher is not there. While waiting to be picked up, she meets some kids playing a game and joins them. When Mr. French sees her new friends, he realizes they are just looking to get in trouble.
Bill falls over one of the twin's toys, and realizes they constantly have toys out which makes the place messy. Bill tells the twins that any toy left out will be taken away from them.

programmes.st: Take Me out of the Ballgame
programmes.d: Jody and Buffy try out for the stick-ball team that plays on their street. Only one of the twins has skill and is accepted on the team.
Jan tries to prove her worth by trying out for cheerleading.

Bobby and Cindy are asked by their older siblings to stay out of their way, then are told they weren't invited to their Aunt Gertrude's wedding. In a fit of self-importance, they set out to set a world's record for teeter-tottering.
Greg and Marcia use their dates to get back at each other; the younger Brady siblings prepare for the school carnival by building a dunking tank.
Peter eavesdrops on his family by using a tape recorder.

programmes.st: And Now A Word From Our Sponsor
programmes.d: The Bradys are cast for a laundry soap commercial.
Greg cracks a rib while trying out for the football team.

The Bunkers are having problems with their furnace which gets Archie entertaining the idea of moving. When an unscrupulous black real-estate salesman, Mr. Byrd, offers Archie a hefty sum of money for his home, Archie is all for it despite Mike's warnings.

Archie comes home from work in a particularly awful mood because he has to make an important decision at work. His decision to lay off a Puerto Rican leads to an interesting visit to the Bunker household.

It's Christmas Day and Archie is the only one not in the Christmas spirit. Mike and Gloria question him, but he refuses to reveal what's bugging him. The Jeffersons come over to wish the Bunkers a 'Merry Christmas'.

Archie comes home from work in a great mood and orders Edith to have dinner ready and waiting, because he has to watch the CBS Evening News to see himself on it. Archie was interviewed as a man-on-the-street voicing his opinions on Nixon's presidency.

Edith has been running herself ragged caring for Archie, Mike and Gloria, who have all come down with a terrible flu. This prompts her to call on her extremely liberal Cousin Maude to come and stay with the Bunkers and help out.

Archie, Mike and Gloria are stunned when Edith becomes a rollercoaster of moods, going from joy to anger to tears in a snap of a finger. Gloria sits her down and suggests that perhaps she's beginning menopause.

The Bunkers are celebrating Edith's birthday in the city when Archie discovers that Edith failed to mail out a payment to the insurance company. This leads him to run across the street to drop it off. On his way, he gets stuck in an elevator.

A man shows up at the Bunker's door claiming to be a government agent and begins asking questions about a neighbor of the Bunkers. Archie soon becomes paranoid when he receives a phone call from a neighbor saying that Archie too is being investigated.
When Bubba videos his family for a school project, demonstrating their loudness and rudeness, Mama is excused from organizing a charity event that she didn't want to organize.
Mama puts Bubba in a bind with his boss when she returns a gift that wasn't meant for her and spends the money buying presents for everyone else in the family.
When an ATM gives Mama $800 without charging her account, the family agrees she should keep it. But she returns to the bank and meets the man from whose account it was withdrawn.

Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for Best Classical Solo Vocal Album "Crazy Girl Crazy" (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) in 2018 and took home the Grammy for Artist of the Year in 2022.

programmes.t: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programmes.d: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

programmes.t: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programmes.d: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.

programmes.t: Piano Duets -- Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o
programmes.d: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.

programmes.t: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programmes.d: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37; pianist Maya Oganyan makes her solo debut with the orchestra.

programmes.t: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
programmes.d: In this August 2020 concert at the Lucerne Festival, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15 with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra; Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36.

programmes.t: Liszt's Concerto No. 1 & Mahler's Symphony No. 5
programmes.d: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Fifth Symphony; Lukáš Vondráček is the soloist in Liszt's First Piano Concerto.

programmes.t: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programmes.d: Following the life of Clara Schumann, wife of the composer Robert Schumann, revealing her personality from different angles with testimonies from those who knew her, performers of her music and her biographers.

programmes.t: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programmes.d: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

It takes nine years and the work of cutting-edge forensic toxicologists to solve the murder of a medical examiner's wife. Then, a determined Alabama sheriff reopens the case of the deaths of two babies, hoping to get their mother to confess.
March 1984. Jack Kennedy discovers his daughters brutally murdered. Their mother and niece spend their lives keeping the case alive. DNA leads nowhere. 30 years later, an informant gives up a name.

New DNA technology and the national DNA databank help police hunt down a rapist-killer 11 years after he committed his crimes, and a detective's painstaking recreation of a woman's shooting death proves it wasn't an accident.

A killer authors a book about his con-man past that becomes the key to solving a 29-year-old cold case of two high school sweethearts--and three other cold case murders--leading police to believe he could be the Zodiac Killer.
In July 1997, the brutal murder of 19-year-old Tiffany Johnston rocks the small town of Bethany, Oklahoma. DNA points to her killer over a decade later and leads investigators across state lines.

Guns found dumped in a pond help police to solve the 15-year-old murder of Detroit cab company owner. And the rape and murder of an Atlanta TV station receptionist goes cold for 20 years before DNA links a man to the crime.
In the heart of Cajun country, young mother Brenda DuPont is found murdered in her home in May 1988. The initial investigation sputters and turns cold, but her sister Linda vows to solve her murder.

After 19 years, Kansas detectives reopen the case of a banker found beaten to death in his bed--and the chief suspect is his cheating wife. And a man with a guilty conscience helps Arkansas police to crack a cold case of murder.
Bill Kurtis examines one of the most infamous cold cases in Los Angeles history.

Looks at how law enforcers stick with cases for many years, using fresh evidence to win convictions or to free prisoners who were wrongfully jailed. We examine the unsolved murder of Hogan's Heroes star Bob Crane.

In June 1985, a 20-year-old "Sucker Day" Festival Queen is found brutalized. The small community of Nixa, Missouri, is certain her blood is on the hands of a local wealthy businessman, but after 25 years DNA reveals the true killer.

In 1983, Navy seamen Sonny Grotton left base for a long weekend at home. But as he pulled into his driveway, a gunman killed him. And in 1993, former state trooper Doug Wright claimed his estranged wife shot and killed herself in their home.

When Sherry Leighty goes missing in 1999, her family is left wondering how a dedicated mother of three could vanish without a trace. A decade later, the cold case heats up when Sherry's sister launches a social media campaign.

13 days after Pam Pitts disappears in 1988 her charred body is found at a popular hangout spot in the Arizona desert. When a second victim is discovered in a mineshaft, detectives suspect the killer may have known them both.

programmes.st: The Widow And The Wolf/Texas Drifter
programmes.d: After the murder of her aunt goes cold, a woman helps launch an advocate group that brings awareness to cases that have gone unsolved.

A high school janitor is suspected in the murder of a young girl, but with only circumstantial evidence to go on, police must let the case go cold. And a woman asks the police to reopen the 24-year-old case of her cousin's disappearance.
While working on the school yearbook, Daria takes a liking to a formerly homeschooled student with many eccentricities.
When Daria and Jodie are invited to tour a school for gifted students, their parents struggle to get along, and Quinn finds herself at odds with her own friends.
Rumors begin to swirl at school when a mysterious rash sends Daria to the hospital.
Lawndale High holds a medieval fair to raise money for a new library roof, and Quinn tries out for the lead in a play.
The broads say goodbye.
Abbi and Ilana experience major wardrobe malfunctions on the way to a friend's gallery show and embark on a desperate search for a public bathroom.

Montez offers to buy the guys tickets to an electronic music festival, but Colleen's baby shower threatens to ruin their good time.
The guys are riding high after taking side jobs as a clown troupe, but the prestige of their new lifestyle quickly goes to their heads.
When Karl agrees to give Blake his penis, Ders begins filming the process as a documentary while Adam undertakes his own project to eat a thousand hot dogs.
Using Karl's new legal weed connection, the guys set up their own weed and burrito restaurant, but tensions arise when Karl and Ders prove to be terrible bosses.
The guys put the entire office in danger after showing off their office-pranking skills in front of their favorite undercover business reporter.

Two black students compete for a cappella supremacy, Andre and Meegan go on their first date, and would-be terrorists get caught up in the food truck business.
Choir members squabble over pitch, a barbarian warrior tries out a new bit, and a prisoner toys with a gullible guard.

When Reid and Garcia are abducted by Benjamin Merva (Michael Hogan), it's up to the rest of the team to find them. The BAU finds surprising clues in their own history to solve why the two heroes have been targeted by a mass murderer.

When the BAU is called to Kansas City to investigate a series of murders, a tense reunion ensues between Blake and her father, a retired police captain, and her brother, a detective, who must work together to help solve the crime.
The BAU continues its murder investigation in Texas, and clues uncover a deep web of corruption that could be the motive for the killings.
While Reid copes with a loss in his personal life, the rest of the BAU travels to San Francisco to investigate victims discovered in the Mission District.
When a prominent attorney goes missing in Boston, the BAU unearths secrets in his past which could point to the reasons for his disappearance.

The BAU searches for an UnSub who is purposely disfiguring victims. Also, Rossi has an awkward reunion with his ex-wife, Hayden Montgomery, who kept his daughter, Joy, a secret from him for nearly 30 years. Sheryl Lee Ralph guest stars.
When a young boy goes missing from his home in St. Louis, the BAU reinvestigates a similar cold case to search for the UnSub.
The BAU investigates when several young men and women are victims of disfiguring acid attacks. Also, Dr. Reid begins to settle into his new surroundings. (TV-14 D, L, V)
When the BAU goes to San Jose to investigate a string of murders, Garcia delves into her hacker past and reconnects with her old flame to help the team with the case.
When an UnSub in Miami sensationalizes his crimes by giving the local media exclusive footage, the BAU is called in to investigate.
The BAU takes charge of a hostage situation at a law firm in D.C., where Matt Simmons' wife, Kristy (Kelly Frye), works. (TV-14 L, V)
The BAU investigates victims who were documenting their personal lives and inner desires on blog posts and social media. Also, Kevin gets jealous when he learns Garcia may have a new love interest.
The BAU travel to Rapid City after two male victims are discovered murdered in a ritualistic manner. Also, Reid continues to grieve over Maeve's death.

When several federal government employees, including a close friend of Walker's, succumb to symptoms of a heart attack, the BAU investigates. Also, Reid anxiously awaits his trial date. Jane Lynch guest stars.
When an UnSub targets the BAU, the team goes into action to find out who is responsible.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: It's week five of training camp and Kelli is out sick.  DCC Technical Director, Kitty Carter, fills in and runs the first rehearsal of the week.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Week 7 of training camp begins with a rehearsal on the field at Cowboys Stadium.  Kelli and Judy are ready to make final cuts and tonight's rehearsal could determine who makes the squad.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: It's time to announce the DCC squad but first Kelli and Judy put the candidates through a final field rehearsal at Cowboys Stadium.  Tensions run high among the girls as Kelli and Judy watch their every step.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The squad has their first game day performance behind them, but after a bad rehearsal, Kelli warns her new team she will cut girls if they don't give 110 percent.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders take a break from the sidelines and travel to Mexico for their annual swimsuit calendar photo shoot.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are in full dance mode preparing for their first regular-season home game performance. Kelli and Judy want the choreography to be perfect and press the girls through a few intense rehearsals.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: In the final episode of the series, the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are preparing for their marquee performance - The Susan G. Komen Cancer Awareness Halftime Show during a nationally televised Cowboys football game.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Dreams are on the line as the tryouts for the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders 2013-2014 squad begin.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The pressure is mounting as 54 new candidates compete with 32 returning veterans for an invitation into the famed Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders training camp.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Training camp begins at the Cowboys famous training facility, Valley Ranch. First Meeting is filled with excitement and energy until Kelli calls a special meeting of the veterans.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The "scariest night of training camp" kicks off this dramatic episode as the girls learn the dreaded jumpsplit! It's mind over body, as the girls attempt this famed and required move.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The ladies are really challenged when guest choreographer DJ Guthrie teaches them a new dance style.  Kelli and Judy have some tough decisions to make about who will remain on the squad.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The training camp candidates hold their breath as the one and only Kitty Carter pays a visit to training camp.  Kitty takes no prisoners as she rips into the new girls as well as the vets.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With their futures on the line, the training camp candidates try to push through their heightened emotions to show Kelli and Judy they deserve to be part of America's Sweethearts.  Unfortunately, for some "Tonight will be your last night".

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: This is it, the last chance, as the girls finally learn their fate. Dreams start coming true as the girls pose for Squad Photo.  There is some great dancing as Show Group and the rest of the squad perform for the first time at a new "Meet The Team" event.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Begin the journey to see who will survive the most demanding dance audition in professional sports. 500 ladies put their dreams on the line as they try to become a famed Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader, for the 2014-2015 season.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With 55 high caliber girls making it to finals, it's intimidating for the 30 veterans as they join the audition process & must fight to keep their place. Kitty Carter takes no prisoners as she prepares girls for their solos.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As training camp begins with 43 ladies, the pressure starts to build!  Kelli's passion is infectious and intimidating in First Meeting, as she sets the expectations very high.  Seven girls will be cut to make a squad of 36.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Fear takes over for the new Training Camp Candidates as they face the reality of doing the DCC kick line & jump splits for the first time. Dreams come true if only temporarily, as the girls try on the uniform for the first time.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: To be a DCC, you need to look like a DCC.  This week Kelli makes sure all the girls have the look.  The final rehearsal of the week brings emotions to the forefront as a girl gets sent home.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As the candidates enter the sixth week of training camp they need to start looking like a DCC or their spot is in jeopardy.  Melissa Rycroft and former DCC Tina Kalina sit in for Judy and give Kelli some fresh eyes.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With three girls left to cut and the first game around the corner, the pressure is intense as the girls return to AT&T Stadium to take the field for the first time since auditions.
Bret surprises the final four with a trip to Las Vegas. One girl's lies cause Bret to question her intentions toward him.
Bret wants to know more about the three remaining girls, and what better way to get the 411 than moving their parents into the house!

programmes.t: Rock of Love: Brets Rock of Love
programmes.d: Bret takes his final two girls south of the border to spend some quality, romantic time with each one before making his final choice.
Tonight Bret and all of the girls reunite to rekindle the friendships and rivalries that made the house such a unique place.

programmes.t: Rock of Love: The Clip Show
programmes.d: A look back at the outrageous and funny moments that never made the show.

programmes.d: Flavor Flav welcomes 20 new women to his mansion with the hope of finding someone real this time around.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Flav is Blind
programmes.d: Flavor Flav challenges his remaining fourteen Flavorettes to a blind speed dating competition (to get to know them without the influence of physicality-ness).

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: She Works Hard for Her Honey

programmes.d: Twelve girls are left and jealousy is running rampant. Flav divides the girls into groups of six and presents them with two challenges.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Jelly on the Telly
programmes.d: Flavor Flav wants a girl who knows how to move.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Famous Friends and Strangeness
programmes.d: Flavor Flav knows everyone who's anyone in the hip hop industry and today he wants to have them all over to his house.

programmes.st: Who Loves New York? (Photo Shoot To The Death)
programmes.d: Just like last season, Flav has invited a special guest from his past to help give him input on his selection of ladies.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Boxin' Each Other Out
programmes.d: The five girls left want the inside scoop, so he puts all five of the girls in the parlor with a ballot box and pictures of themselves.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Steppin' Out Flav Style

programmes.d: Flavor Flav and all 20 of the Flavorettes from season 2 are back for a reunion show like you've never seen before.

Steve responds to a call where earlier a man chased another man out of a store with a gun.
When Dr. Wesley, Dean of the medical school, is arrested for sale of narcotics, she pleads her innocence to Mark. Meanwhile, Mark's student Quinn and neighbor Jennifer plan to marry.
While out on his morning jog, Jesse unsuccessfully attempts to save a man who has locked himself in his gargage with the engine running, an apparent suicide.
After Madison hears that Lisa, a personal friend and one of her star students, has missed a few classes, she visits her and finds Lisa comatose from a drug overdose.
It's a case of mistaken identity when Greg, a mobster who looks just like Mark, is released from prison and moves into Mark's neighborhood.
Jesse operates and removed the bullet from Greg, thinking he is Mark. But everything starts to unfold when mark show up for his shift at the hospital.
Mark's patient and shock-jock radio talk show host Denise announces her nation-wide search for her birth mother and jokes that she'll kill her if she doesn't want anything to do with her.
A woman is murdered during the burglary of her opulent Malibu home, a burglary in which a rare diamond, part of a set of famous Russian jewels known as The Seven Deadly Sins, is stolen.
As preparations for the hospital's Christamas party swing into high gear, Claude, a popular hospital maintenance man, who each year portrays Santa Claus at the big bash, collapses.

Dr. Mark Sloan finds himself needing a vacation from his vacation when his plans for a relaxing trip abroad a cruise liner as a doctor is turned upside down as a family finds their father has been murdered.
Mark and Amanda have brough their kids to the set of Frontier Dad, a popular western TV series, to watch the filming of an action sequence.

Dr. Mark Sloan finds himself in the middle of another murder investigation that hits too close to home.
Dr. Mark Sloan finds himself in unfamiliar territory when a string of murders seem to be connected to a state of the art computer system and its not so stable inventor and owner Bruce Locatelli.

Mark and Steve return home from a fishing trip to a shocking discovery - the bloody and beaten body of Mickey, the young medical student who, along with his wife Jill, also a medical student, had been house-sitting for them.
Steve reluctantly goes on a dating game show and wins. Much to his pleasnat surprise, his date appears to be everything he's looking for and more.
Steve gets an unexpected phone call from Hawk, an old friend from the police force who has recently retired and moved into the Sunny Meadows rest home.

Holly, a Labrador puppy, displays severe food aggression; a women's shelter will take a needy woman and her pit bull, Tucker, but Cesar must help the dog become less protective first.
